headline: Public hearing on the Amendment to the Greatest Practical Extent Ordinance and the new Institutional Zone Ordinance.
summary: The agenda starts with routine items and the minutes from November 4, 2026. Two ordinances are then reviewed during the open public hearing.
items: Review of the Amendment to the Greatest Practical Extent Ordinance
Review of the new Institutional Zone Ordinance
plain_text:
City of Biddeford 
Planning Board 
November 18, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
City Hall Council Chambers & Teams 
Third Wednesday Planning Board Meeting | Meeting-Join | Microsoft 
Teams 
 
 
  
1. Pledge of Allegiance 
2. Declaration of Quorum/Voting Members 
3. Adjustment(s) to Agenda 
4. Planner's Business 
5. Consent Agenda 
 5.a Approval of Meeting Minutes from November 4, 2026. 
6. Open Public Hearing 
 6.a The Planning Board will review the Amendment to the Greatest Practical Extent 
Ordinance. 
 6.b The Planning Board will review the new Institutional Zone Ordinance. 
7. Close Public Hearing 
8. Unfinished Business 
9. New Business 
10. Other Business 
11. Adjourn 
 The Board reserves the right to halt official business at 9:30 p.m. Items not heard at 
tonight's meeting shall be rescheduled to the next meeting of the Board. All materials 
pertaining to items on the agenda are available for public review at the Biddeford Planning 
Department, second floor, Biddeford City Hall during normal business hours.
